concepts.name: Decimal Numbers
concepts.description: Decimal numbers represent parts of a whole using a decimal point. They provide an easy way to express quantities smaller than one in everyday situations.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify and read decimal numbers up to two decimal places.

concepts.name: Decimal Point
concepts.description: The decimal point separates the whole number part from the fractional part of a decimal number.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to correctly identify the whole and decimal parts of a number.

concepts.name: Decimals in Daily Life
concepts.description: Students encounter decimal numbers while using money, measuring length, weight, and capacity.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to recognize decimal numbers used in real-life situations.

concepts.name: Tenths Place
concepts.description: The first digit to the right of the decimal point represents tenths, where each part is one-tenth of a whole.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify the tenths place in decimal numbers.

concepts.name: Hundredths Place
concepts.description: The second digit to the right of the decimal point represents hundredths, where each part is one-hundredth of a whole.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify the hundredths place in decimal numbers.

concepts.name: Place Value of Decimal Digits
concepts.description: The value of each decimal digit depends on its position relative to the decimal point, similar to whole numbers.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to determine the place value of digits in decimal numbers.

concepts.name: Comparing Decimal Numbers
concepts.description: Decimals are compared by examining the whole number part first, followed by the tenths and hundredths places.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to compare two decimal numbers using comparison symbols.

concepts.name: Ordering Decimals
concepts.description: Decimal numbers can be arranged in ascending or descending order by comparing their place values.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to arrange decimal numbers in ascending and descending order.

concepts.name: Equivalent Decimal Representations
concepts.description: Some decimal numbers represent the same value even when additional zeros appear after the decimal point, such as 2.5 and 2.50.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify equivalent decimal representations.

concepts.name: Money Calculations
concepts.description: Decimal notation is commonly used to represent rupees and paise. Students solve practical problems involving purchases, bills, and change.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to solve money-related problems using decimal numbers.

concepts.name: Measurement Using Decimals
concepts.description: Measurements of length, weight, and capacity are often expressed using decimal numbers for greater accuracy.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to interpret and use decimal numbers in measurement problems.

concepts.name: Real-Life Problem Solving
concepts.description: Students apply decimal concepts to solve everyday problems involving shopping, measurement, and data interpretation.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to solve real-life mathematical problems involving decimal numbers.

concepts.name: Understanding Tenths and Hundredths
concepts.description: This chapter develops an understanding of decimal notation, place value, comparison of decimals, and their applications in money and measurement.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to read, compare, interpret, and apply decimal numbers in practical situations.
